department: Department of Mathematics and Computer Science

deadline.value: Doctoral applications can be made at any time, though committees do not meet during lecture-free periods, so delays may occur.
deadline.quote: You may apply and be admitted at any time.

gre_subject.value: The regulations mention no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A professor must declare they are available to supervise the doctoral project, and the declaration must be submitted with the application.
supervisor.quote: A declaration from a professor that they are available to serve as supervisor and examiner for the doctoral research project must be submitted.

funding.value: The regulations do not say whether doctoral students are funded.

entry_route.value: The regulations require a master's degree in a closely related subject, with a bachelor's admission possible only as an exception.
entry_route.quote: The applicant must have obtained a master’s degree by examination in a subject closely related

notes: One set of regulations (2020, English translation) covers Mathematics and Computer Science, so CS is listed here as also_fields. The English text is an unofficial translation; the German text is binding.
